about.heroTitle: The school sent home 12 pages. Only 4 sentences mattered.
about.heroBody: Paper Bridge reads the stack your kid brought home, pulls out what's due, what costs money, and what needs a signature — in your language — and drops the dates straight onto your phone calendar.
about.noAccount: No account needed. Photos are never stored.
about.step1Body: Snap every page your kid brought home — flyers, forms, newsletters, up to 8 at once. Blurry is fine.
about.step2Body: Only the sentences that ask you to do something: a due date, a fee, a signature, an RSVP. Everything else is dropped.
about.step3Body: Tap once to add every date to your phone. Payments and signatures get a reminder two days early.
about.whatTitle: Four kinds of things. Nothing else.
about.whatBody: Whole-document translators give you twelve pages in Spanish. We give you the four lines that would have cost you something if you missed them.
about.kDeadlinesBody: Permission slips, registration windows, picture day.
about.kMoneyBody: Field trip fees, yearbook orders, lunch balances — and free-lunch enrollment that saves you money.
about.kSignBody: Anything that needs your name on it before it goes back in the backpack.
about.kReplyBody: Conference sign-ups and RSVPs — with a polite English email already drafted for you.
about.trustTitle: Every item shows the exact English sentence it came from.
about.trustBody: So a bilingual cousin, an older sibling, or the teacher can check it in one glance. We would rather show our work than ask you to trust a black box.
about.t1: Photos are processed and discarded. We never store them.
about.t2: Results live for 30 days at a private link, then disappear.
about.t3: No account required to decode a stack.
about.t4: Tested against real newsletters from public school districts.
about.endBody: Free during SASEhack 2026. No sign-up, no app to install.
